Dataset.description: The ground truth: where it is and how it is read.

transcription.description: the name of its transcription in the page records
transcription.title: Transcription

importer.description: what made the page records from the dataset: a linecaster reader (alto, page, hocr, docling, text, markdown) or the evaluation's own (module:function)
importer.title: Importer

Dataset.title: Dataset

ElementSettings.description: How elements are cut and matched (``linecaster.evaluation.elements``, ``linecaster.evaluation.matching``).

lane.description: the lane elements are matched by: alnum (letters, marks and digits of any script) by default, whatever the scored lanes
lane.title: Lane

tables.description: which tables are tables: data (printed as tables; linecaster.evaluation.tables) or all; the rest is text
tables.title: Tables

containment.description: the least share of an element that must lie in its match
containment.title: Containment

short.description: an element shorter than this many units needs that similarity instead
short.title: Short

ngram.description: the n-grams of units candidates share
ngram.title: Ngram

stop.description: an n-gram in more elements than this counts for none
stop.title: Stop

max_cells.description: past this many aligned units a page is one group
max_cells.title: Max Cells

ElementSettings.title: ElementSettings

PageSet.description: The pages scored: a sample rule (``linecaster.data.sample``) or an explicit list, with its hash.

rule.description: a sample rule: seed, items, per_item, pages
rule.title: Rule

ids.description: the page ids, when the set is a list
ids.title: Ids

sha256.description: sha256:<hex> of the page ids, sorted, one per line (data.sample.listing_sha256)
sha256.title: Sha256

PageSet.title: PageSet

Supports.description: What the ground truth has, so that metrics needing what it lacks are not computed.

continuations.description: it marks paragraphs continued across pages
continuations.title: Continuations

Supports.title: Supports

description:
A benchmark definition (``linecaster.benchmark/2``): ``benchmark/1`` with the lanes as comparison strategies of
the catalog, the output strategy both texts are written with, and the unit a character error counts.
``read_benchmark`` reads a ``benchmark/1`` as one: its lanes by the strategy that does the same, the unit
``codepoint``.

policy.description: the rendering policy both sides are rendered with
policy.title: Policy

output.description: the output strategy both texts are written with (literal: as read)
output.title: Output

unit.description: what a character error counts: a grapheme cluster (what a reader sees as one character) or a code point
unit.title: Unit

words.description: the tokenizer of the word metrics (linecaster.evaluation.tokens): uax29 (Unicode's word boundaries, the default), whitespace or characters
words.title: Words

elements.description: how elements are cut and matched (with element metrics)

strata.description: page or item fields to report rates by
strata.title: Strata

title: Benchmark
